payload.summary: Enabled OPENCUT_LEGITATE_CLIENT_ID=opencut-local in ignored local .env.local, backed up previous environment, left OPENCUT_LEGITATE_ONLY=false pending real verification per integration policy. Live API reports configured=true. Logged into existing local itay account and started browser-bound linking; reached real Legitate login page without client or callback error. User prompted to log in there; authentication credentials are not available. Existing binding absent, existing local account/project scope preserved. Browser handoff tab 2 in IAB browser 2; screenshot .local/legitate-setup-20261102/legitate-login.png. OIDC transaction expires after five minutes; if expired restart link from existing authenticated local session. Next work: verify real callback binding and subsequent sign-in, then enforce Legitate-only if verified.
